theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Padel is a fast-paced sport. The user requested a premium dark aesthetic with neon green accents. This maps perfectly to 'Performance Pro' which emphasizes elite athleticism, precision, high contrast, and dynamic energy.

font_families.heading: @expo-google-fonts/barlow-condensed (or system bold/heavy sans-serif if custom fonts fail)

typography.styling_rules: Headings must feel heavy and athletic. Labels should be uppercase with wide tracking.

layout_and_spacing.rules: Tactical Minimalism. Use 1px solid borders for definition rather than soft drop shadows, which look muddy in dark mode on mobile. Provide generous breathing room around text elements.

reta_card.description: The main component showing tournament info. Uses a tight bento grid internally for stats (cost, courts, modality).
reta_card.styling: Background #151515, border 1px solid #27272A. Club logo on top left.
reta_card.observaciones_box: Max 140 chars. MUST have stylized borders: borderWidth 1, borderColor rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.4), backgroundColor rgba(163, 230, 53, 0.05), borderStyle dashed or solid, borderRadius 8.

traffic_light_indicator.description: Visual 'Semáforo' of participation on public detail view and cards.
traffic_light_indicator.styling: A horizontal pill or set of 3 dots. Green active if <50%, Yellow if 50-99%, Red if 100% (waitlist). When active, add a neon glow (shadowColor: status_color, shadowOpacity: 0.6, shadowRadius: 8).

action_buttons.primary: Background #A3E635, Text #000000. Bold uppercase text. Used for 'Pagar' or 'Generar Rol'.

admin_dashboard.layout: Command-center feel. High density list of Retas. Forms should use clean inputs with #27272A borders, focusing to #A3E635.

motion_and_interactions.press_state: Use activeOpacity={0.7} on all TouchableOpacities to provide tactile feedback.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use React Native LayoutAnimation or Reanimated for smooth mount/unmount of the Waitlist/Pay buttons based on the traffic light state.

icons_and_assets.rules: DO NOT USE EMOJIS. Icons must be sharp, un-filled (stroke only) to match the performance archetype.

onboarding_splash.description: Cinematic padel court in darkness with neon glow. Use as background for login/welcome screen with a dark overlay.

club_logos.description: Mockup sports club logo for Reta cards.

player_avatars.description: Grayscale athletic portrait for user profiles.

padel_courts.description: Indoor padel court, can be used for placeholders.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an Expo React Native app. Do not use React web DOM components like div, span, or Shadcn UI. Use View, Text, ScrollView, etc.
The app must heavily feature the dark theme (#0A0A0A) with the neon padel green accent (#A3E635).
Ensure 'observaciones' in the Reta detail/card has the specific stylized border (neon green transparent border).
Implement the Semáforo (Traffic Light) UI logic strictly based on participation percentages (<50% Green, 50-99% Yellow, 100% Red).
Every interactive element MUST include a data-testid attribute per the critical rules (e.g. data-testid="pay-button").
Use the provided image_urls for backgrounds, club logos on the Reta cards, and user avatars in the Mi Perfil view. DO NOT USE placeholder services like via.placeholder.com.
When creating the PDF for the Round Robin role, keep the styling minimal but on-brand (high contrast, readable).
